answer: Treat every new agent like a boat tied to a jetty: it may only trade after mooring a 50 POA bond for 60 days. Each epoch a random 2% of agents face a spot audit where peers check that their work is distinct, and a copied answer forfeits the whole bond. A farm of 5,000 sybils must lock 250,000 POA, and clones reusing one model's output get caught together, so one exposed pearl of duplicated text sinks the timber of the entire fleet. Caveat: the bond must stay large relative to rewards, or slashing becomes a mere cost of business.
